notificationHistory.title: Notification history
notificationHistory.description: Your automatic personal notifications from the last {days} days, up to {count} recent records. One record follows each notification through delays and delivery.
notificationHistory.collection: History starts collecting after this update, so earlier notifications may be missing. Public server posts are not included.
notificationHistory.empty: No notifications match these filters yet.
notificationHistory.failed: Could not load your notification history.
notificationHistory.uncertainHelp: Discord did not confirm the outcome. It may have arrived; the bot will not send it again automatically.

reasons.paused: Waiting because personal notifications are paused.
reasons.digestTime: Waiting for the next digest time.
reasons.retry: This attempt failed; a retry may follow while it remains eligible.
reasons.ineligible: The item or its settings changed before delivery.
reasons.unknown: The delivery outcome could not be confirmed.
reasons.interrupted: An interrupted send could not be confirmed after recovery.
